Rahul Gandhi Urges Support for Local Traders Amidst Protest

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi urged attendees of a rally to support local traders ahead of the festive season, linking this call to an ongoing protest. Traders have claimed that approximately 3 lakh shops were shut due to the protest. Gandhi also alleged that the BJP was responsible for the closure of shops and the resulting losses to traders.
